text.tspan: Tested surprise: deletion works on whole blocks
Chart drops its ONLY pod annotation
The 3-way merge deletes at the level where OLD and NEW differ.
Server-side apply kept restartedAt in both cases: it has its own owner (kubectl-rollout).
